understanding.goal_understanding: Place every selectable piece onto the goal tile(s) marked with '+' so that all goals are occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN and complete the run.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: A piece is controlled after it is selected (typically via CLICK on the piece). MOVE_* actions shift the currently selected piece one grid step in that direction unless blocked by walls/obstacles or an immovable object; if the destination is blocked, the piece does not move. CLICK can also be used to attempt to select/switch to another piece or interact with an object, but if the clicked location is not a valid selectable/interactive target, nothing changes. Pushing only occurs if the game rules allow a movable object to be displaced into a free cell; otherwise movement is blocked.
